description: Returns the screenshot (base64 JPEG) from the trace closest to the moment of failure. Use when get_aria_accessibility_tree returns an empty or unhelpful tree — the image shows exactly what was on screen. Pass screenshot_index to retrieve any specific screenshot from the trace (0-based); omit to get the one nearest to the failure.

screenshot_index.description: 0-based index into the screenshot list. Omit to get the one at failure.

trace_path.description: Absolute path to trace.zip, or a URL (https://) to download it from

name: get_screenshot_at_failure
